3139-5226-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3139-5226-5660-6769.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
3139-5226-5660-6769.description:
Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}. 
When The Great Henge enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing The Great Henge, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning The Great Henge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

529-1753-3197-8181.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1011-2728-4153-5256.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-4153-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-4153-5256.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 4.

3129-4365-5478-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
3129-4365-5478-6441-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1170-2642-4050-7519.description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten and Dovescape trigger.
Resolve the Dovescape trigger, countering the prepared spell and creating a number of 1/1 flying Bird creature tokens equal to its mana value.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Emeritus of Woe // Demonic Tutor, which enters prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Bird token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to cast the prepared spell.
Repeat.

1558-3756-3875-4231-6753.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-3756-3875-4231-6753.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1558-2638-3478-4231-6441.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3478-4231-6441.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3755-4629-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate The Incredible Hulk by tapping it, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.

413-4559-5805-7306.easyPrerequisites: At least two opponents have lost life this turn.
413-4559-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
413-4559-5805-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gev.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-2043-6311-7296.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Urza's ability, targeting Radiant Lotus.
Resolve both Urza abilities, creating two token copies of Radiant Lotus that are 1/1 Soldier artifact creatures.
Activate a Radiant Lotus token by tapping it and sacrificing both Radiant Lotus tokens, targeting yourself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying the Radiant Lotus token's ability, targeting yourself.
Resolve both Radiant Lotus abilities, adding twelve mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

560-1563-1753-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-4331-4993-6556.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2585-4300-6871.description:
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning Grim Monolith from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Walls of Ba Sing Se

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to The Walls of Ba Sing Se

1055-4222-7059.description:
Activate The Walls of Ba Sing Se by tapping it, causing a player to mill thirty cards.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping The Walls of Ba Sing Se.
Repeat as mana allows.
1055-4222-7059.notes: This combo can be repeated each turn as mana allows.

560-1563-2457-6965.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Soldier and a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate the Insect and Soldier by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

394-2034-5220-6705-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
394-2034-5220-6705-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

1429-6792-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

2908-3497-3682-5542.easyPrerequisites: You've gained at least one life this turn.
2908-3497-3682-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying one mana.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Dream Stalker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

141-6471.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
141-6471.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Will of the Temur
141-6471.description:
Cast Will of the Temur by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Will of the Temur, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Will of the Temur, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.
141-6471.notes: You can choose both modes if you control a commander as you cast Will of the Temur to get infinite card draw for any number of players.

2781-2885-4605.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Rescue the Foal.
2781-2885-4605.description:
Cast Rescue the Foal by paying its mana cost, blinking Felidar Guardian.
Felidar Guardian and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

3995-4137-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
3995-4137-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Blossom-Clad Werewolf's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2511-3542-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
2511-3542-5140.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Palinchron, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Repeat.

813-957-2665.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Scholar of the Ages.
813-957-2665.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, taking two extra turns after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages.
When the token Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Stretch and up to one other instant or sorcery card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3663-4679-4772.notablePrerequisites: Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
3663-4679-4772.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Three Blind Mice.
The Three Blind Mice tokens enter the battlefield with two lore counters on them due to Doubling Season, triggering their first and second chapter abilities.
Resolve the first Three Blind Mice triggers, creating four 1/1 Mouse creature tokens.
Resolve the next Three Blind Mice trigger, creating two token copies of a Three Blind Mice token.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite Three Blind Mice triggers, you may use them to copy any token(s) you control.

2034-2459-5150-5224.manaNeeded: {1} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2034-2459-5150-5224.description:
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Rograkh enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bramblewood Paragon.
 Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Rograkh.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rograkh, adding {C}{C}.
When Rograkh dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Rograkh to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-2034-3263-3490.notablePrerequisites:
Ingenious Scholar on the battlefield as Jetfire, Air Guardian.
Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-2034-3263-3490.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting three +1/+1 counters on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

1090-4344-5144.description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield, causing Restoration Angel to return to the battlefield.
Restoration Angel and Lumbering Battlement enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Lumbering Battlement trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking Lumbering Battlement.
Repeat from step 2.

2103-3429-3554.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Invent by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Invent and Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

618-3246.description:
Activate the mutated Cavern Whisperer and Kiki-Jiki creature by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat.
